scope: 1959 SNU public-administration/public-health institutional implementation network after Decree No. 1429
method_note: This file expands institutional actors without treating academic participation as political office. It is a research-neighbor graph feeding later politician/official attribution. Names are not promoted into the politician registry unless public-office evidence warrants it.
